# Workout Guru

> > Workout Guru is a free fitness platform offering comprehensive exercise databases, workout routines from beginner to advanced, and health calculators including Body Adiposity Index (BAI), Ideal Body Weight (IBW), and Waist to Height Ratio tools.

The site provides structured workout plans for muscle building, weight loss, and overall wellness, featuring exercises across multiple equipment types including Olympic Barbell, Kettlebell, and Bosu Ball. Users can browse exercises by body part, training mode, or equipment type.

## Core Resources

- [Free Exercises, Workouts And Nutrition For Optimal Health](https://workoutguru.fit): Homepage featuring exercise database, workouts, and fitness calculators
- [Unlock Your Fitness Potential With A Free Exercises Database](https://workoutguru.fit/exercises): Comprehensive exercise library with movements from barbell to bodyweight
- [Unleash Our Workout Routines Database! Get Fit For Free!](https://workoutguru.fit/workouts): Main workout routines database with beginner to advanced training plans
- [Workout Plans - Workout Guru](https://workoutguru.fit/workouts/workout-plans): Personalized workout plans for muscle building, weight loss, and wellness

## Exercise Directory

- [List Of Exercises A-Z - Workout Guru](https://workoutguru.fit/list-of-exercises-a-z): Alphabetical directory of all exercises with pictures from A to Z
- [Strength Exercises - Workout Guru](https://workoutguru.fit/exercises/mode-strength): Filtered catalog of strength training and resistance exercises
- [Back Exercise - Workout Guru](https://workoutguru.fit/bodypart/back): Back-focused exercises including rows, pull-ups, and stretches
- [Plyometrics Exercise - Workout Guru](https://workoutguru.fit/mode/plyometrics): Plyometric and jump training exercises for explosive power
